$comment: A COMMITTED COPY of this repository's GitHub Actions artifact-and-log retention, the
same kind of record as actions-allowlist.json: a repository setting written down so a
gate can hold the tree to it offline.
WHY IT MATTERS. GitHub caps every upload at this value whatever its `retention-days:`
says. housekeeping.yml asked for 30 on its gate-costs artifact, and gate-costs-c277f2ab
(created 2026-10-05T10:16Z) expired 2026-10-08T10:11Z: three days. A workflow that
asks for more than this reads as a promise nobody keeps, and code that samples N
artifacts back (gate_costs.SAMPLE_CAPTURES) was sized against that promise.
an unreadable one (an expression it cannot evaluate), and a missing or malformed
record here. It never writes a setting.
`days`, `maximum_allowed_days` and `refreshed_at`. Lowering the setting makes the gate
red on every line above the new value, which is the point.
